# ffxf_images (Data Source)

Lists FFXF Cloud images, optionally filtered by region, plan, or category.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ffxf = {
      source = "ffxfnet/ffxf"
    }
  }
}

provider "ffxf" {}

data "ffxf_images" "catalog" {
  region   = "montreal"
  plan     = "nano"
  category = "linux"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `category` (String) Keep only images in linux, windows, bsd, app, or other category.
- `plan` (String) Keep only images compatible with this compute plan.
- `region` (String) Keep only images offered in this region.

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) Images matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Image category.
- `default_user` (String) Default operating-system user.
- `family` (String) Operating system or application family.
- `min_disk_gb` (Number) Minimum disk size in GiB, when specified.
- `min_memory_mb` (Number) Minimum memory in MiB, when specified.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `regions` (List of String) Available region slugs.
- `slug` (String) Stable image slug.
- `status` (String) Availability status.
- `supports_ssh_keys` (Boolean) Whether SSH key provisioning is supported.
- `version` (String) Image version, when applicable.
